subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@kitebank.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@kitebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Priya / Samir,

Thanks again for your time today — great discussion. Quick recap from the demo and a proposed POC plan to validate Redwood against KiteBank's requirements.

Demo recap (high level):
- Use case: assist agents with transaction triage and customer intent classification + summarization for compliance review.
- Model profile: 4k context LLM (open model variant we demoed) with embedding-based retrieval for KB and KV cache for session continuity.
- Performance we saw (on demo dataset): ~120ms median token latency; 98% of responses within your 500ms soft SLO.

Proposed 2-week POC (evaluation plan):
1) Success criteria (mutually agreed):
   - Intent classification F1 >= 0.87 on your labeled sample (primary)
   - Latency: 95th pctile end-to-end < 800ms for 99% of requests
   - Throughput: sustain 200 concurrent sessions with <10% tail latency increase
   - No PII leakage in logs; audit trail enabled
2) Scope & data: we'll use a 5k-row deidentified dataset from KiteBank (you provide), plus a 500-row labeled holdout for evaluation.
3) Timeline (target):
   - Week 0 (kickoff): access & dataset handoff, account setup
   - Week 1: integration, small-scale runs, initial metric collection
   - Week 2: full evaluation runs, quality/regression checks, final report
4) Ownership & contacts:
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (PM, commercial lead), Dev Patel (solutions engineer)
   - KiteBank: Priya Shah (product lead), Samir Gupta (engineering)
5) Deliverables:
   - Evaluation report (metrics + failure modes)
   - Recommendations (batching/quantization/cache settings)
   - Short runbook to reproduce results

Next steps:
- If this plan looks good, confirm dataset delivery (secure upload link) and preferred kickoff date next week. I attached the POC plan and the demo recording for your notes.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: KiteBank-POC-Plan-v1.pdf, KiteBank-Demo-Recording-20270422.mp4
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@kitebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.g@kitebank.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — quick questions before we lock the kickoff:
1) Data residency: can the POC run in our US-only region and ensure logs are retained for 30 days only (no long-term storage by Redwood)?
2) For the labeled holdout, is 500 rows sufficient to reliably measure F1 for intents with skewed distribution? Could we instead do 750 labelled rows?
3) On the latency numbers you shared, can you provide a short note on the test harness (payload sizes / typical prompt length)?

Also looping in Samir to confirm engineering bandwidth for next week.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Product Lead, Conversational Ops | KiteBank
priya.shah@kitebank.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@kitebank.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@kitebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T19:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Priya — great questions.

1) Data residency / retention: Yes — for POCs we can spin up a US-only private enclave (Redwood Dedicated slice) and configure logs to 30-day retention. We'll document and provide the data handling addendum. Rishi will be the security contact.
2) Labeled holdout: 750 rows is fine and advisable given skew. We'll update the evaluation plan to request 750 labeled holdout rows.
3) Latency testing notes: median/tail numbers were captured with a 7-token prompt for classification and a 150-token generation for summaries; payloads included a 3KB context (de-identified transcripts). I'll attach a short test-harness notes doc in the drive link.

Attached: KiteBank-POC-SOW-v1.pdf (SOW draft). I'm proposing kickoff on Monday 2027-04-26 — does that work for you?

Best,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: KiteBank-POC-SOW-v1.pdf

Date: 2027-04-23T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — integration checklist

Hi Priya/Marissa,

Technical/checklist notes for kickoff:
- Auth: we'll need a service account key from KiteBank (scoped to POC bucket) or temporary S3 creds via your infra team.
- Schema: please include 2 example transcripts and the mapping doc for label fields (intent, sub-intent, conversation_id).
- Sandbox endpoint: Redwood will provision a dedicated POC endpoint with fixed capacity; expect credentials within 24 hours of kickoff.
- Monitoring: we'll provide Grafana dashboard access and a short alerting config for latency/error rates.

Proposed kickoff: Mon 2027-04-26 10:00 AM PT — I can run a 30-min tech sync (integration steps + test run).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

We confirm: 750 labeled holdout rows; US-only data; 30-day logs. Kickoff accepted for Mon 2027-04-26 10:00 AM PT. I'll get our infra to send temporary S3 creds ahead of time; Samir will own that handoff. Also adding our compliance lead (Lena Ortiz) to the kickoff invite.

Next steps for Marissa: send calendar invite + secure upload link and final SOW.

Regards,
Priya
